text: This report transmits materials submitted by the Board of Directors of Lakeshore Arena Corporation (LAC) to the City. No independent review or analysis has been performed by City staff. Representatives from the Board of Directors for Lakeshore Arena Corporation (LAC) have confirmed all financial information was made available to the auditors for the performance of the audit. This report recommends actions necessary to comply with the requirements of the Business Corporations Act, Ontario (OBCA) for holding the Annual General Meeting of the Shareholder of Lakeshore Arena Corporation (LAC), including receipt of its Annual Report and Audited Financial Statements (Statements) for 2021 and appointment of the auditor for 2022.
